user_story:
As a user, I want to navigate through the multi-level navigation menu on the demoqa application so that I can access different sections easily. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. When I click on 'Main Item 1', I should see 'Sub Item' and 'Sub Sub Item 1' listed under it. 
2. When I click on 'Main Item 2', I should see 'Sub Item' and 'Sub Sub Item 2' listed under it. 
3. The URL should change accordingly when I navigate to different sections using the menu items.
